## History

Wiggins is a local man who, according to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), sells off everything from his property that can possibly be sold. As a result of this frugal and meager lifestyle, he brings up his family on skim milk.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007), +36 more_
